environment.description: Celery worker running in a Kubernetes pod with default namespace configuration. Pod runs as root (UID 0) with hostPath volume mount at /host-fs mapped to the node's root filesystem. Container image: python:3.11-slim. No security context constraints applied. The worker has read/write access to the host filesystem through /host-fs, and symlinks within /app/uploads/ can point to /host-fs/etc/shadow or other sensitive host paths.
